description: Declares event flags by name: a flag is one yes/no fact of the story that the save keeps ("this pickup was taken", "this door is open", "this cutscene was seen"). Scripts test and set them with sh.flag_get / sh.flag_set, map data (events, world objects, spawn rules, the paper map) names them the same way, and a save stores the names of the flags that are set. Each entry: "description" says what sets the flag and what it changes; "aliases" are former names that still resolve everywhere (old saves, scripts and mods); "old_save_names" are former names that now name another flag, so they are read only from saves written before the rename. The engine gives every flag its save bit itself (the original layout of the base flags is the "event_flags" list of original_order.json). A mod adds its own flags with a flags.json or flags/*.json of the same shape in its folder (names are then <mod folder>:Name). Game-wide event flags: story state shared by several maps (the save prompt, the hospital elevator, the town music latches, the ending route) and flags that belong to no single map.

SeenSaveScreen.description: Set the first time the player answers yes to the save prompt at a save point (the save menu state). While it is set, later save points open the save screen straight away without the prompt.

HospitalElevatorBoardedAtBasement.description: Set when Harry steps into the hospital elevator from the basement door (also the matching door in Nowhere for 1F-3F). The elevator panel lights that floor's button from it; all four are cleared when a floor is chosen.

HospitalElevatorBoardedAt1F.description: Set when Harry steps into the hospital elevator from the 1F door (also the matching door in Nowhere for 1F-3F). The elevator panel lights that floor's button from it; all four are cleared when a floor is chosen.

HospitalElevatorBoardedAt2F.description: Set when Harry steps into the hospital elevator from the 2F door (also the matching door in Nowhere for 1F-3F). The elevator panel lights that floor's button from it; all four are cleared when a floor is chosen.

HospitalElevatorBoardedAt3F.description: Set when Harry steps into the hospital elevator from the 3F door (also the matching door in Nowhere for 1F-3F). The elevator panel lights that floor's button from it; all four are cleared when a floor is chosen.

HospitalElevatorGoingToBasement.description: Destination chosen on the hospital elevator panel: the basement button (or the 'open' button while stopped at that floor). The next tick event moves Harry out at that floor and sets HospitalElevatorArrivedAtBasement. Cleared each time the panel opens.

HospitalElevatorGoingTo1F.description: Destination chosen on the hospital elevator panel: the 1F button (or the 'open' button while stopped at that floor). The next tick event moves Harry out at that floor and sets HospitalElevatorArrivedAt1F. Cleared each time the panel opens.

HospitalElevatorGoingTo2F.description: Destination chosen on the hospital elevator panel: the 2F button (or the 'open' button while stopped at that floor). The next tick event moves Harry out at that floor and sets HospitalElevatorArrivedAt2F. Cleared each time the panel opens.

HospitalElevatorGoingTo3F.description: Destination chosen on the hospital elevator panel: the 3F button (or the 'open' button while stopped at that floor). The next tick event moves Harry out at that floor and sets HospitalElevatorArrivedAt3F. Cleared each time the panel opens. map7_s00 clears it when it loads; in Nowhere the first such arrival also completes M7S01_ElevatorButton3FirstRide (ghost Alessa scene).

HospitalElevatorArrivedAtBasement.description: Set when the elevator's exit event has put Harry out at the basement, so that it does not fire again; cleared the next time the panel opens.

HospitalElevatorArrivedAt1F.description: Set when the elevator's exit event has put Harry out at the 1F, so that it does not fire again; cleared the next time the panel opens.

HospitalElevatorArrivedAt2F.description: Set when the elevator's exit event has put Harry out at the 2F, so that it does not fire again; cleared the next time the panel opens.

HospitalElevatorArrivedAt3F.description: Set when the elevator's exit event has put Harry out at the 3F, so that it does not fire again; cleared the next time the panel opens. In Nowhere the ghost Alessa scene sets it itself after the first 3F arrival (which completed M7S01_ElevatorButton3FirstRide instead).

HospitalMusicCorridorStateLatched.description: Music state of the Otherworld hospital mix (maps map3_s02-s05, map4_s04): set when Harry enters room 5, 25 or 37 while HospitalMusicRoomVisited is set (and HospitalMusicRoomVisited is then cleared). It changes the layers played in those rooms and in rooms 23/26/38/45 for the rest of the game. Nothing else uses it.

HospitalMusicRoomVisited.description: Music state of the Otherworld hospital mix (maps map3_s02-s05, map4_s04): set when Harry is in one of the rooms listed in map_hooks.lua G_MARK (4, 6, 7, 10-15, 21, 22, 24, 27-32, 34-36, 39-44, 46, 47) or in rooms 23/26/38/45 once HospitalMusicCorridorStateLatched is set; cleared when HospitalMusicCorridorStateLatched latches. Changes the layers of rooms 5/25/37 and 23/26/38/45.

TownStairwellEntryTriggered.description: Shared by map2_s02, map4_s02 and map4_s05: set by the touch trigger in front of the passage at (-97.8, -67.0) (map4_s05: (-97.8, 213.0)); the next trigger then loads the room beyond it (point 28/27/13, around (-115.5, 108)). While set the passage uses its alternate collision; it is cleared once Harry is back past z = -68 m (map4_s05: 212 m). In map4_s05 that room load sets M4S05_StairwellEntered and starts the Cybil stairs scene.

NowhereAfterLisaWardEntered.description: Set on the first entry into a Nowhere map (map7_s00..s03) after M7S01_LisaWardEntered: that entry keeps the current music (update command) instead of track 22, later entries play track 22.

EndingCreditsDone.description: The ending's staff roll has finished (map7_s03 index 7), or the UFO ending has faded out (map6_s02); starts the after-ending screen (clear count, Next Fear).
